title: Published 0.1.0 was already behind 0day within hours — port the contract changes and release 0.2.0
description:
Two contract changes landed in 0day AFTER the extraction and were missing from the published package:

1. One coupling vocabulary. EDGE_KINDS (names plus descriptions) lived in derive.ts while EDGE_KIND_VALUES (the enum) lived in the contract, with nothing keeping them equal. Now a single declaration with the enum derived from its keys, so adding a name without a description is not expressible.

2. The cross-reference refinement on SiteMap: every kind used must be described in edge_kinds, and every resolved_by must name a key in resolution. Neither is expressible in JSON Schema, nor in capnp, which is why this layer stays hand-written when the contract is re-rooted.

The second matters more for a package than it did for 0day. Inside 0day, resolved_by to resolution was enforced indirectly by re-deriving and diffing against a committed artifact. A consumer running their own extractors has no committed artifact to diff against, so the guarantee did not exist for them at all.

0.2.0 rather than 0.1.1: this rejects documents that previously parsed, which under 0.x is a minor bump.

Verified in the BUILT dist rather than in source. Gate green, workerd 5/5, fidelity byte-identical at 52145 bytes.

Standing note: pnpm rewrites workspace:* to an EXACT version, so collect pins core exactly and every core release forces a collect release. Fine for two packages in lockstep, worth revisiting before it is six — workspace:^ emits a caret range instead.
acceptance_criteria: The built dist rejects an edge whose kind is absent from edge_kinds and whose resolved_by names no resolution rule; task check passes; versions are 0.2.0.

title: Onboard rsry bead tracking + pre-commit framework
description: Set up .beads/ (SQLite store), AGENTS.md, and .pre-commit-config.yaml matching the convention shared across canonical-hours/cloister/rosary/mache: rsry's bead-export-sync hook, prettier auto-fix on commit, basic file hygiene, task ci as a pre-push gate.
acceptance_criteria: pre-commit run --all-files passes clean; rsry hooks status reports current hooks
